_comment: The fired-clay palette's ONE home in the shipped project. The web export only carries data/** (export_presets.cfg), so design-system/tokens.json cannot be read at runtime; these values mirror its color block exactly, and tests/test_palette.gd fails the build if the two ever drift. Change a colour there first, then here. Rule zero still applies: pigment does not glow — these are flat mineral fills and drawn contour lines, never gradients or shadows.
